reason: Our clothes have always been washed by hand at home and it gets done; I have never felt we needed a machine, so I am not going to start with one that costs twenty-two thousand. If I ever did buy, a plain semi-automatic at the block market would cost about half this.
objection: I am paying double for a battery to cover power cuts in a machine I don't even use today. And a lithium battery in a village house, who knows how long it really lasts and what replacing it will cost after three years.
would_change_my_mind: If the women of the house were no longer able to hand-wash, or my daughter-in-law insisted, and the price came close to an ordinary semi-automatic, around twelve or thirteen thousand.
